questions.prompt: An idempotent runbook script is one that…

options.b: is safe to re-run: an unchanged system means a no-op

questions.prompt: `config_changed` uses `! cmp -s src dst` — the function succeeds (returns 0) when…

options.a: the files differ, i.e. there is work to do

questions.prompt: `systemctl restart` succeeded, yet the script still runs `systemctl is-active` — because…

options.a: restart can 'succeed' and the unit can still die a moment later; verify state, don't trust the verb
options.b: is-active is what actually starts the unit
